content.text: {"title":"Adding search to the help centre","situation":{"text":"The help centre at Example Support had no search, so people emailed support for answers that were already written down.","quotes":["The help centre had no search, so people emailed support for answers that were already written down."]},"task":{"text":"I built the search as a two-person project with a designer.","quotes":["I built the search as a two-person project with a designer."]},"action":{"text":"We indexed the articles and added a search box to every page.","quotes":["We indexed the articles and added a search box to every page."]},"result":{"text":"Support emails about questions already answered in the help centre went down, according to the support lead.","quotes":["Support emails about questions already answered in the help centre went down, according to the support lead."]},"atomIds":["5a0e8f3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"],"competencies":["customer-impact","collaboration"],"followUps":["How did you decide how to index the articles and where to put the search box?","How did you and the designer split the work?"]}
